verdict.rationale: The pack has no dedicated test mode, test API keys, or sandbox account separate from production. The only indirect paths are the AGPL open-source build that can be self-hosted as an isolated instance, and webhook testing guidance for local development. The "Browser Sandbox" item describes managed browser sessions for interactive scraping, not an isolated test environment, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: a documented sandbox/test environment or test-mode keys, separation of test vs. production data/usage, and independent corroboration.
